title: Hit effects
desc: Construct shatter, knockback shockwave and outline flash on a punch, each alone and all three together; J picked "hit effects (construct shatter pixels, knockback shockwave, glowing outline flash)".

takes.name: Construct shatter
takes.facts: 64-pixel wall breaks outward, 3 ticks per block of distance, 0.22/(0.6+d) blocks a tick, gravity 0.01, shrinks out over 16 ticks; step-punch, wind-up from 14, hit at tick 20

takes.name: Knockback shockwave
takes.facts: ground ring to r 4 in 10 ticks, air ripple in 6; mob thrown out 0.8 / up 0.5 blocks a tick, gravity 0.08, drag 0.98; step-punch, wind-up from 14, hit at tick 20

takes.name: Outline flash
takes.facts: green shell on for 3 ticks, gone by 9; 24 sparks for 9 ticks; mob rocks 12 deg; step-punch, wind-up from 14, hit at tick 20

takes.name: All three
takes.facts: wall shatters, then 2 ticks later shockwave, knockback, outline and sparks; step-punch, wind-up from 14, hit at tick 20
